content: Opportunity has hair upon its forehead, but is bald behind; seize it by the forelock as it approaches, for once it passes, none can catch it.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Kairos (Καιρός) — Epigram of Posidippus & Classical Myth Lore
explanation: In ancient Greek statuary, Kairos (the divine moment of opportunity) had a thick forelock of hair in front, but the back of his head was completely bald. When the golden hour approaches, you must seize it face-to-face; once it passes, you reach out with empty fingers and grasp nothing.
practicalInsight: Do not hesitate when an open door of opportunity presents itself today. Step through before it closes.
reflectionPrompt: What golden opportunity is standing before you right now that you risk missing through over-analysis?
